snippet.title: Hotel Investigation 09 - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383670/Hotel_Investigation_09/

After discussing with some people, the page for Hotel Investigation 09 - Shipwrecked 64's official followup, will be a full length game on steam, instead of an experimental browser title.

Hellsite: https://x.com/SqueaksDCorgeh
Second Channel: @DeuxCorgeh 
Companion Playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2qBMOPjfrD7OzVTe0-9K0XwuiwpakuI0&si=BJljdgcEyDyrORa-
Song: Travel - HI-09 soundtrack by @lithoan
Studiotoons Bumper - Voice by @TheGameSalmon


https://youtu.be/y45V8emNVGM?si=HG9Tso--spyUmEum
https://youtu.be/3GxL0eMLILE?si=5hX9WWWoArwHDcWX
